hero.name: Aarón Bocanegra
hero.description: Systems engineer with 13+ years building web and desktop applications on .NET. I have worked on cloud enterprise platforms with AWS and React, industrial automation, and public sector projects. I co-founded Grodivo and enjoy turning ideas into products that scale.
hero.sceneAlt: Scene from the DevMan game: the hero runs across the city shooting bugs. Press to shoot.
hero.photoAlt: Photo of Aarón Bocanegra; on hover it turns into his 8-bit character

game.title: DevMan: the game
game.speaker: Dr. Dilly
game.message: This portfolio is the front door. Behind it there is a full game: eight stages, eight bugs turned into bosses, and an armor hidden in capsules like this one. I am building it with Phaser and TypeScript, and all the art is generated from code.
